anna (docs): Quick bug discovered in /v1/files docs. The multipart curl example uses Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="upload.txt" but our Python and JS snippets set "filename" in the JSON body for the wrapper. Some customers report empty filename on S3 uploads. I'll open a small docs PR to make all canonical examples use multipart filename consistently.
kevin (sdk): Thanks. JS SDK was serializing the FormData key as {file: blob, metadata: {filename: 'upload.txt'}} and relying on server to pick metadata.filename. That pattern is fragile. We should show explicit multipart filename and optional metadata field.
omar (api): Root cause: the server will prefer Content-Disposition filename when present; fallback is metadata.filename. So both behavior paths exist but docs only showed the metadata approach. We'll update server docs to recommend Content-Disposition for curl + fetch examples.
anna (docs): I'll add two examples: 1) curl with multipart Content-Disposition filename 2) fetch/+FormData example setting file name explicitly 3) python requests example that uses ('file', ('upload.txt', open('upload.txt','rb'), 'text/plain'))
kevin (sdk): I'll push a patch to the JS SDK to always set the filename on the FormData entry when callers pass a name or a File/Blob with name property. I'll add a runtime test covering browsers + node fetch FormData polyfill.
julie (qa): Can we add a small e2e test that uploads via examples page to our staging S3? We had a flaky bug where filename=='' broke downstream processing. I can add a test case in the docs CI that runs the curl example and asserts object key contains upload.txt.
omar (api): Good idea. We'll also add a short migration note: "If you relied on metadata.filename only, prefer Content-Disposition filename for maximum compatibility with proxying S3 setups."
ci-bot: docs preview build passed - preview: https://deploy-preview-9999--docs.redwood.ai/ (CI: \u2714)
kevin (sdk): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/420 - adds filename coercion + tests.
anna (docs): Draft docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9001 (WIP) - includes three examples and the migration note. Tagging @kevin @omar.
julie (qa): I'll queue the e2e check in staging and report back. If it fails we hold the docs merge.
kevin (sdk): Will include a changelog entry noting behaviour change (more explicit filename handling); non-breaking.
anna (docs): Thanks all. I'll merge once SDK tests and staging e2e pass; will post an announce in #support and #product to notify integrators.
